integrity: An analytic proof over all n,m,t is supplied. Finite exact-arithmetic and independent convex-hull checks are corroborating evidence only, not a replacement for infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only one parallel vertex truncation of an affine simplex; no universal sharp stability exponent, global rate or multi-vertex classification established. A possible older unindexed equivalent frustum calculation remains a novelty risk.
title: Exact Godbersen mixed-volume profile for one-vertex simplex truncations
